title: יקנעם — הבית שבקצה
brief: כחול: מחלקה שהגיעה בחסות הבתים ממזרח מטהרת את הבית שבקצה המערבי של יקנעם עילית, בלי סיוע אש. אדום: כיתה מחזיקה בבית, פניה אל השטח הפתוח במערב. לפני הקרב כל צד מתכנן את משימתו.

window.place: The southern edge of Yokneam Illit on Ramat Menashe (יקנעם עילית, רמת מנשה): the town's houses on the hill in the south-east, Route 6 (כביש 6) in the west, low ground to the north.

about: One defended house, built so most battles end in a fight inside it and the
plan's levers (decision 101) can be told apart (the author, 2026-10-20). The
house is the town's westernmost, osm-w634373319: 130 m2, two storeys with
stairs, open ground for 250 m and more to the west.
First laid out with the platoon 300 m west in the open: the fight was decided
outside (rifle grenades broke the squad, or its fire broke the platoon), and
5 battles in 100 reached the house. So, by the author's ruling, the platoon
starts already up against it: 19-23 m east, in the cover of the neighbouring
houses, as the raid inserts its force. The approach is not the question here;
the fight inside is. Its windows still face the open ground to the west, the
way the squad's prepared position looks.
A RED squad holds it, 3 m inside the west wall (at the house's middle a man
cannot see out through 6 m of his own house, nor be seen). A BLUE platoon of
three squads and its command group: three to one at the point of assault, and
enough for decision 100's next squad. No indirect fire. Regular, experienced
on both sides.
The house, the strengths and the start against the house are the author's
(2026-10-20). ⚠️ Ours: the exact positions, the 90-turn limit (a defended
house takes about an hour to clear: decision 96's calibration), the force
quality, and the squad facing west.
